# PipelineOn Open Attribution

> MIT-licensed website attribution, normalized outcomes and optional advertising delivery. Start at docs/setup.md.

Use the docs and code at the same commit. Links below follow main; replace main with the installed tag/commit when needed. Read package.json and local validation before implementing. Instructions do not grant account access, spending or publication authority.

The kit needs Node.js 24.14.x and persistent SQLite. A Cloudflare Worker can run the provided pixel proxy or a separately built adapter, not the unchanged kit. PipelineOn and the kit use different API wrappers. Worksheets are templates, not executable connectors; keep completed copies private.
